import json,subprocess,re
from v3_revision import ROOT
base=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','cbce398:manuscript/working-paper/paper-content.json']));now=json.loads((ROOT/'manuscript/revision-v3/paper-content.json').read_text())
old=[b for s in base['sections'] for b in s['blocks'] if b['type']=='table'];current=[(s['title'],b) for s in now['sections'] for b in s['blocks'] if b['type']=='table']
labelmap={'SCALED_KNN':'Scaled KNN','TB':'Treasury'}
def normalize(cell):
 t=str(cell)
 if t=='SCALED_KNN':return labelmap[t]
 if t=='TB' or t.startswith('TB '):return 'Treasury'+t[2:]
 return re.sub(r'\br\b','ω',t)
def rows(b):return [[normalize(x) for x in row] for row in b['rows']]
matches=[]
for b in old:
 found=[(s,c) for s,c in current if rows(c)==rows(b)]
 assert len(found)==1,(b['caption'],len(found))
 section,c=found[0]
 matches.append(dict(original=b['caption'].split('.')[0],current=c['caption'].split('.')[0],rows=len(b['rows']),section=section,unchanged_numeric_cells=True))
print(json.dumps(dict(original_tables=len(old),original_rows=sum(len(b['rows']) for b in old),all_rows_retained=True,permitted_label_changes={'r':'ω','SCALED_KNN':'Scaled KNN','TB':'Treasury'},matches=matches),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
